title: Trademarks
slide_intent: Teach a reader where to find the edition’s naming, credit and logo-use provisions. Indentation lets a dense set of conditions be scanned at several levels.
strategic_value: Slack can separate references to the company name from instructions about the mark’s appearance and attribution.
demonstration: The left text column begins with permitted and discouraged uses of the word mark. Marking instructions continue across the gutter into logo sources, clear space and use provisions.
practical_value: Find the relevant subheading for wording, attribution or logo spacing. Follow its numbered items and carry the continuation onto the following page.

content_islands.name: Word-mark usage
content_islands.spec: Set nested do and do-not lists under the left-column heading. Indent each level consistently so each example belongs to its rule.

content_islands.name: Marking and logo usage
content_islands.spec: Continue the marking text at the top of the right column. Follow with the asset references, space requirements and the first item of the next list.
